name: UofL Health

ahrq.src: AHRQ Compendium of U.S. Health Systems, 2023, matched to CMS's hospital list (the site's June 2026 pull)

hc.src: Medicare hospital cost reports (CMS HCRIS, Worksheet S-3), fiscal year 2024 file

subs: Beds on its Medicare cost report. A licensed bed count usually runs higher.
Every intensive and special care unit counts: adult, cardiac, surgical, burn, neonatal and pediatric.
Each inpatient stay that ended counts once, whoever paid for it.
All inpatient days divided by discharges. Answer in days, like 4.5.
Patient days divided by the bed days it had available.
Medicare Advantage plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Medicaid managed care plans included. Counted in days spent in a bed, not in people.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payroll only: not clinics, not contract staff.
Interns and residents: doctors training after medical school. Two half-time count as one.
From AHRQ's 2023 list of who owns which hospital, matched to Medicare's hospital list.
Every one of its hospitals' latest Medicare cost report, added up.
Biggest by beds on its cost report. The answer names the hospital.
Two half-time employees count as one. Hospital payrolls only: clinics, offices and any health plan are left out.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did - Shelbyville Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That is the fewest of 3 UofL Health hospitals; - Jewish Hospital and Mary has the most, 4,165. About 5.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did - Jewish Hospital and Mary have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: No other UofL Health hospital reports more; University of Louisville Hospital is next at 2,731. About 5.3 for every bed.

questions.q: How many full-time-equivalent employees did University of Louisville Hospital have on its payroll in fiscal 2025?
questions.why: That ranks second of 3 UofL Health hospitals; - Jewish Hospital and Mary has the most, 4,165. About 8.2 for every bed.

questions.q: What percent of - Shelbyville Hospital's inpatient days in fiscal 2025 were for Medicare patients?
questions.why: No other UofL Health hospital runs higher; - Jewish Hospital and Mary is next at 40 percent. Traditional Medicare was 33 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 44 percent.

questions.why: That ranks second of 3 UofL Health hospitals; - Shelbyville Hospital runs highest, 77 percent. Traditional Medicare was 15 percent and Medicare Advantage plans 26 percent.
